name: First touch
tip: Bank shots off any black border. Drag and kick again even while the ball is moving.

name: Up the ramp
tip: A solid rising triangle sits below the peaked roof. Use its slope or clear its tall end.

name: Over the edge
tip: The triangle faces the other way: clear its vertical face, then follow the downhill slope.

name: Under one roof
tip: The supported platform has a flat top and a descending slope. The roof steps down too.

name: Full speed ahead
tip: The green floor surface throws the ball to the right. Its arrows show the impulse direction.

name: Against the flow
tip: The orange surface throws the ball left. Kick in the air to clear it or use the rebound.

name: Double trouble
tip: Two triangles face each other beneath a low roof. Keep control through the middle.

name: Thread the gap
tip: Pass between the hanging roof triangle and the floor triangle. You can correct mid-flight.

name: Moving target
tip: The block slowly travels from floor to ceiling. Pick your moment or adjust a moving ball.

name: The red line
tip: Touching the red strip returns the ball to its start. Every kick already taken still counts.

name: Stair play
tip: Climb the two steps, then use the open roof to reach the net.

name: Twin peaks
tip: Carry momentum over two ramps. The valley gives you room to correct.

name: Under and over
tip: A ceiling baffle leaves a generous low route; bank shots can work too.

name: Green runway
tip: Use the green runway before the ramp, or clear both with an arc.

name: Against the grain
tip: The orange strip reverses rolling balls. Stay above it or use a bank.

name: Safe crossing
tip: Land on the shelf or loft the red strip. Every reset keeps your kicks.

name: The low window
tip: The hanging baffle and low ramp leave a clear middle passage.

name: Moving lane
tip: The travelling block opens a low lane. Time the boost or aim over it.

name: Return pass
tip: A ramp and reverse strip ask for control before the slow gate.

name: One more goal
tip: Choose the high route or use the shelf to cross the red strip and gate.

name: First Bounce
tip: Roll onto the upward spring to clear the low wall; a mid-air kick can carry you farther.

name: Angled Launch
tip: The diagonal spring sends the ball across the arena. Bank off the roof or correct the approach.

name: Double Bounce
tip: Chain the rising spring and the forward launcher, or steer between them in flight.

name: Tailwind
tip: Enter the blue airflow low down and feel its steady push toward the net.

name: Updraft
tip: The upward fan can carry a slow approach over the wall; exit the airflow toward the goal.

name: Against the Wind
tip: Two air currents offer a low assisted route and a headwind to fight or clear.

name: Breakthrough
tip: A firm impact breaks the cracked timber barrier. A lofted shot is another option.

name: Two Routes
tip: Break the low shortcut barrier or take the open high route above the shelf.

name: Chain Reaction
tip: Break a sequence of three barriers, keeping control between impacts.

name: Open Sesame
tip: Touch the blue floor switch to raise the matching gate. Its connector shows the target.

name: Timing Window
tip: Touch the airborne switch to open an eight-second gate, then keep your momentum.

name: Two-Step Puzzle
tip: The first floor switch opens the near gate; the second opens the exit gate.

name: Moving Paddle
tip: Observe the slow paddle, then pass beneath it or use a deliberate rebound.

name: The Swing
tip: The hanging timber swings over a low ramp. Use the opening or bank around it.

name: Pinball
tip: Two slow paddles turn in opposite directions. Pick your bank or recover mid-flight.

name: Slippery Start
tip: The pale blue strip carries rolling momentum farther. Shorter kicks may be enough.

name: Ice Run
tip: Slide into the approach, then loft the low wall or use a corrective kick.

name: Slopes and Slides
tip: Land on the polished downhill ramp and use gravity to carry the ball toward the net.

name: The Workshop
tip: Use the spring to clear the barrier, or break through it and activate the gate switch.

name: Grand Finale
tip: Use spring and airflow above the shortcut barrier, or break through and open the timed exit. Recover any time.
